translations.text: To whom have the roots of wisdom been revealed, and who knows the hidden depths of understanding?

Do not reject her teaching, do not waver, and do not bring greater disgrace upon yourself, lest the Lord increase your bonds and cast you down in the assembly, because you have been negligent in the fear of God and your heart is full of deceit.
Woe to you, mighty men of confidence! What will you do when the Lord judges?
Those who fear the Lord will not reject his word, and those who love him will keep his ways.
For God's mercies are many, and mysteries are revealed to the humble.
Do not seek things too difficult for you, and do not investigate things beyond your strength.
Water extinguishes a blazing fire; likewise, giving to the poor brings forgiveness of sins.
Wisdom has taught her children and will enlighten all who understand her.
Do not rely on unjustly gained wealth, for it will not help you on the day of distress.
Put your foot into her snare, and put your neck under her burden.
Answer your companion as well as you can, and share your confidence with the wise.
In all your wrongdoing, do not wrong your friend, and do not walk in the way of the proud. Keep away from all sins and falsehood, and do not walk with an arrogant spirit.
The Lord uprooted the traces of the proud and erased their memory from the earth.
Free people will serve a wise slave, and an understanding person will not complain when disciplined.

Do not take on something heavier than you can bear, and do not associate with someone richer than you. For what partnership can an earthenware pot have with a bronze cauldron, which strikes it and breaks it? Or what partnership can a rich person have with a poor person?
Take care and be watchful, for you are walking among robbers.
Wealth without sins is good, and poverty accompanied by sins is bad.
A person's heart changes their face, whether for good or for bad.
If you have the means, my son, provide for yourself; and if you have the means, treat yourself well.
Remember that until now you have not seen death, and the decree of Sheol has not been revealed to you.
Do not say, 'He made me stumble,' for he takes no pleasure in an unjust person.
He hates all evil and insolence, and he will not give them to those who love him.
Fire burns in the assembly of the unjust, and wrath rules among a people who provoke anger.
He filled its surface with the lives of all living creatures and gathered all their deeds within it.
He filled their hearts with wisdom and understanding and taught them good and evil.
The merit of all people is sealed and stored with him, and the kindness of all people is guarded before him like the pupil of an eye.
Do not be poor, drunken, contemptible, and boastful when there is nothing in your purse.
There is someone who lowers his face while planning evil, and where people do not know him, they call him righteous.
A fool’s gift is not worth it, because his eyes are set on repayment of seven for one.
Someone who builds his house through the strength of his companions gathers stones for his wall.
The heart of a wicked person is like a broken cistern, and throughout his life he will not learn wisdom.
A fool raises his voice in laughter, but a wise man laughs quietly.
Someone who teaches a fool is like someone who eats bread when he is not hungry. When your words come to an end, he says to you, “What did you say?”
Do not accustom your mouth to oaths, and do not sit in a court of law.
I came forth from the mouth of the Most High, and like a mist I covered the earth.
Turn toward me, all who desire me, and delight yourselves in my good produce.
It is better to live beside a lion or a dragon than to live in a house with an evil wife.
A drunken wife is a great source of anger; she is reckless and does not conceal her disgrace.
A lion lies in wait to destroy; so does wickedness lie in wait for those who commit sins.
He will meet with retribution from God, because all his sins are carefully preserved against him.
All who abandon the fear of God will fall into it. Fire will burn among them and will not go out. It will overpower them like a lion and tear them apart like a leopard.
For many borrowers have sought a loan and provoked their lenders.
His father died, and [?] that he had not died, because he left someone like himself behind.
Discipline your son so that you are not mocked; if you laugh with him, he will torment you.
For gladness of heart is a person’s life, and a person’s disposition prolongs his life.
Pain, sleeplessness, exhaustion, torment, and an upset stomach accompany a gluttonous man. Sound sleep accompanies a man who fares pleasantly: he sleeps until morning, and his soul remains with him.
If you do what is written in the Law, you increase your service.
Hear the prayer of your servants according to the desire of your people, so that everyone at the ends of the earth may know that you alone are God forever and ever.
Why were hateful and wicked people created, except to fill the earth with deeds of injustice?
A bad friend draws near to the table, but in a time of distress he stands at a distance.

With a woman, do not commit adultery with her; with an enemy, do not fight. With a merchant about his trade, with a seller about his sale, with an unjust person about doing what is good, with someone who has no compassion about showing compassion, with a hired worker who is dishonest in his work, and with an unjust hired worker, do not share a secret. And do not become an adviser to a servant who wants to cheat his master.
A physician receives wisdom from God and gifts from the king.
For how can someone become wise who holds the blade of a plow, drives oxen, takes pride in oxen, and talks about young cattle?
They will not be exalted in the assembly or sit on the judge’s seat. They will not understand covenants and judgments, comprehend the teaching of wisdom, or understand the proverbs of the wise.
Assemblies will recount his wisdom, and the people will proclaim his praises.
Listen to me, you righteous people, and let your flesh blossom like lilies and like cedars planted beside water. Let your fragrance be sweet like fine spices.
All the works of God are beautiful together, and all were created for their purposes.
Do not fear death, because it is your allotted portion. Remember that those who came before and those who come after share it with you.
How does he return to you the deposit you give him?
A daughter is a very heavy burden to her father, and his anxiety drives away his sleep: in her youth, that she may be disgraced, and by her husband, that she may be hated.
Their descendants stand firm in their covenant, and their grandchildren in good deeds.

The blessing of all those who came before rests on the head of Israel, whom he called, “Israel, my firstborn son.” He gave him an inheritance and established him as the father of the tribes. He went forth and was divided into twelve tribes. Righteous men came from him, and he found favor in the eyes of all the living.
He chose him from among all the living to offer burnt offerings, sacrifices, and incense, and to make atonement for all Israel.
God saw and became angry. He burned them with fire, brought a plague upon them, and destroyed them in the fierceness of his anger.
In the days of Moses, he and Caleb son of Jephunneh acted graciously, standing in the breach for the people, turning the assembly back, and putting an end to the evil report about the promised land.
They alone were spared out of six hundred thousand, to bring them into their inheritance, the land flowing with milk and honey.
He crushed the enemies all around him and took vengeance on the Philistines. He broke their power, even to this day.
He brought famine upon them and tore them apart in his zeal.
By the word of the Lord he shut up the heavens and brought fire down from heaven three times, upon the altar and upon wicked people.
While he was in the world, he saw signs and trials before they came.
Ezekiel revealed the form of the chariot and saw a vision.
May steadfast love remain with Simon and with his descendants for as long as the heavens endure.
The inhabitants of Gebal, the Philistines, and the foolish people who live in Shechem.
